lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Basin, 2064. Blue aisles to the vanishing point, forty-one degrees, and a sound you feel in your sternum rather than hear.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is it. Not the senate, not the campus. Whatever is going to be the Steward is running in this room right now, and it is about six months old.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I would like it recorded that I can feel the shape of this. It is the room I am a copy of a copy of.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Article nine assigns custody of exactly this. I have been arguing about this building for four years and I have never seen it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing in here is guarded. It does not need to be. Everyone who could reach it has already been paid.
